solutions.title: Buffer nodes
solutions.strategy: Collect odd-position nodes followed by even-position nodes, then relink those existing nodes in that order.

timeComplexity.explanation: The list is scanned once to collect values and once to rewrite them.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The reordered node references are stored in an auxiliary list.

solutions.title: Relink in place
solutions.strategy: Maintain odd and even tails, splice alternating nodes, then append the even chain after the odd chain.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is visited a constant number of times.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only a few pointer variables are needed.
